rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a heavy coat worn over other clothes for warmth or protection.

example.english: It’s so cold—remember to wear an overcoat when you go out.
example.traditional: 天氣咁凍，出街記得着件大褸呀。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 dung3 ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 zoek6 gin6 daai6 lau1 aa3
